daily_quests.title: ASX 200 Momentum Rank — Window Functions Challenge
daily_quests.description: Using ASX 200 historical price data, calculate a 30-day rolling average closing price for each stock. Then rank stocks within each date by their momentum (current price vs 30-day average). Use window functions ROW_NUMBER() OVER and a CTE to identify the top 10 gainers and top 10 losers on the most recent date in your dataset. Expected output: a table showing stock symbol, date, closing price, 30-day rolling average, momentum percentage, and rank within that date.

daily_quests.title: NSW Road Crash Data Cleaning & Aggregation
daily_quests.description: Download NSW Road Crash Data and load it into a pandas DataFrame. Clean the dataset by: (1) handling missing values in severity and location columns, (2) standardizing date formats, (3) removing duplicate crash records, (4) converting categorical columns (crash type, lighting condition) to lowercase. Then aggregate crashes by Local Government Area (LGA) and calculate: total crashes, fatal crashes, average number of vehicles involved, and injury rate. Export the cleaned and aggregated results to a new CSV file. Expected output: a cleaned CSV with LGA-level statistics ready for analysis.

daily_quests.title: Australian Wildfire Risk Assessment Pipeline
daily_quests.description: Build an end-to-end data pipeline: (1) Extract wildfire incident data from the Australian Wildfire dataset (CSV). (2) Use Python/pandas to clean location data, parse fire dates, and categorize fire size (small/medium/large based on area burned). (3) Load the cleaned data into a local SQLite database. (4) Write SQL queries to: identify fire hotspots (states with highest fire frequency), calculate average fire size by season, and find the top 5 months with greatest total area burned across the decade. (5) Export results showing temporal and geographic trends. Expected output: a populated SQLite database, cleaned CSV, and a summary report with key fire risk metrics by region and season.
